integrity: The proof is an exhaustive finite projective calculation over \(\mathbb Q(\sqrt2)\). The upper bound comes from the five multiplicity-eight points and the harmonic quadruple on \(z=0\); every surviving lift is then checked against all \(33\) source line equations with exact arithmetic. No numerical approximation is used.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to the displayed \(\mathcal O_{33}\) and does not identify the abstract automorphism group of its full intersection lattice or treat the related \(49\)- and \(61\)-line arrangements. An equivalent computation under different nomenclature remains a residual originality risk.
title: The \(33\)-line octagon arrangement has dihedral projective symmetry of order \(16\)
